title: Translucent ghost-sigil hover preview inside vacant sectors and subtle pulsing threat-threads along any rank, file, or diagonal where a contender holds 2 of 3 sectors.
summary: Diegetic holographic hover ghosting on hovered vacant sectors and pulsating threat-thread lines along critical 2-of-3 collinear vectors.
technical_specification: Compute hover index `sectorIdx = col + row * 3` from `state.pointer.x, y` within lattice bounds (`360x360` at `400,310`). If `state.grid[sectorIdx] === 0` and `state.activeContender === 1`, draw translucent ghost sigil at sector center with sine alpha `0.35 + 0.15 * Math.sin(state.world.time * 0.006)`. Iterate 8 triads: count ownership; if either contender holds exactly 2 sectors and 1 is vacant, calculate threat vector endpoints `(x1,y1)` to `(x2,y2)`. Render animated energetic threat-thread with dash offset `-state.world.time * 0.05` and glow width `2 + 1.5 * Math.sin(state.world.time * 0.01)` in contender's threat tint.
acceptance_criteria: Hovering over empty sectors renders faction-accurate ghost preview with smooth pulsating alpha.
Threat-thread glows immediately along the exact vector whenever any contender holds 2 of 3 sectors.
Threat line vanishes immediately upon cell occlusion or vector resolution.
